features.title: Code and sorcery
features.text: Technomancers prepare arcane spells as programs. A programming language determines which gear they can overclock with magic left over from a spell.

features.title: Overclock and jailbreak
features.text: Cast a non-cantrip spell, then Overclock Gear to boost compatible equipment. Jailbreak spends that boost to add a spellshape and its extra effects to the next spell.

review.notes: Provisional assessment of the named playtest, not the final class. Tech Core is scheduled for October 7, 2026; these entries still describe the playtest and require a separate final-rules update.

ratings.offense: 3–4 → 3–4.5. Provisional playtest estimate: offensive arcane preparation can specialize in area damage.
ratings.defense: 2–3 → 2–3. Six HP and limited armor call for careful positioning and protective magic.
ratings.support: 3.5 → 3.5–4.5. Arcane spells and gear enhancements provide control and party assistance.
ratings.utility: 4–5 → 4–5. Arcane preparation plus technical knowledge offer broad noncombat solutions.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Manage prepared spells, programming language, overclock and jailbreak sequences.
